questions.stem: A 30-year-old male with known HIV infection presents with a persistent cough, weight loss, and night sweats for the past two months. His CD4 count is 180 cells/mm³. A chest X-ray shows cavitary lesions in the upper lobes of the lungs. In the context of India, which organism is the most likely cause of his tuberculosis?
